sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Sad, anxious; harsh temper. Irritable; con-
gestion to head, heat and throbbing.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Pain through sides of head. Violent head-
ache. Cranium swells up in hard lump. Pain intense
over eyes and root of nose. Brain feels enlarged. Hard
nodes, with severe pain. Facial neuralgia. Lancinating
pain in upper jaw.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Red, swollen. Tip of nose red ; profuse, acrid,
hot, zvatcry, thin discharge. Occena, zoith perforated
septum. Sneezing. Nasal catarrh, involving frontal
sinus. Stuffiness and dryness of nose, without dis-
charge. Profuse, cool, greenish, unirritating discharges.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Conjunctiva red, injected; profuse lachry-
mation. Syphilitic iritis. Pustular keratitis and chemosis.
Bony tumors of the orbit.

Ear. — Noises in ear. Boring pain in ears.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Saliva increased. Faintness at epigas-
trium. Cold food and drink, especially milk, aggra-
vate. Much thirst. Throbbing, painful burning. Flatu-
lence.

428

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Menses late, profuse. During menses
uterus feels as if squeezed. Corrosive leucorrhoea, with
subacute inflammatory conditions of the womb in young
married women.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Violent cough; worse in morning.
Pulmonary cedema. Larynx feels raw. Laryngeal
cedema. Awakes choking. Expectoration like soap-
suds, greenish. Pneumonia, when hepatization com-
mences. Pneumococcic meningitis. Stitching pains
til rough lungs to back. Asthma. Dyspnoea on ascend-
ing, with pain in heart. Hydrothorax. [Merc, sulph.]
Pleuritic effusion. Cold travels dowmvard to chest.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Severe bone-pains. Periosteum thick-
ened, especially tibia; sensitive to touch. [ Kali b.;
Asaf.] Rheumatism; pains worse at night and in damp
weather. Contraction of joints. Rheumatism of knees
with effusion. Pain in small of back and coccyx. Pain
in hip, forcing limping. Sciatica: cannot stay in bed;
worse at night and lying on affected side. Formication
of lower extremities when sitting, better lying down.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Purple spots; worse on legs. Acne, hydroa.
Small boils. Glands enlarged, indurated. Hives. Rough
nodules all .over, worse any covering; heat of body in-
tense. Fissured anus of infants. Tendency to oedema-
tous swellings, eyelids, mouth, uvula, etc. Acne rosacea.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
lEorse, warm clothing, warm room, at
night, damp weather. Better, motion, open air.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Antidote: Hepar.
